steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Theatre of Cruelty: not physical pain but ASSAULT ON THE SENSES — theatre should overwhelm the audience, not just tell a story. | Key Fact: Total theatre: using every possible means — light, sound, movement, space, colour — to create a complete sensory experience. | Key Fact: No text dependence: words are not the primary medium — sound, movement and spectacle communicate beyond language. | Key Fact: Ritual and ceremony: Artaud wanted theatre to function like a sacred ritual — transformative, primal, cathartic.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain what Artaud meant by 'Theatre of Cruelty' — why is 'cruelty' misleading? | How would you use Artaud's ideas to create a sensory, immersive experience for an audience? | Compare Artaud's approach to theatre with Brecht's. How do they want the audience to respond differently?
